c334458787e0e770.en: 김에 means while doing something or taking the opportunity.

c334458787e0e770.zh: 「바람에」表示消極原因，意為「因為…結果…」。
c334458787e0e770.en: 바람에 expresses a negative cause resulting in an unexpected consequence.

c334458787e0e770.zh: 「덕분에」表示「多虧…」，用於感謝正面的原因。
c334458787e0e770.en: 덕분에 means thanks to, used for favorable causes.

c41b4f199c50436a.zh: 「자다」的使動形為「재우다」，表示使對方入睡，符合句子語境。
c41b4f199c50436a.en: 재웠어요 is the past causative of 자다 (to put someone to sleep), matching the object 아이를.

c41b4f199c50436a.zh: 「잤어요」為主動詞「睡覺」，無法搭配受格助詞「아이를」。
c41b4f199c50436a.en: 잤어요 is intransitive (slept) and cannot take the direct object 아이를.

c41b4f199c50436a.zh: 韓語中「자다」的使動形不是「자히다」，為錯誤形態。
c41b4f199c50436a.en: 자혔어요 is a non-existent verb form; 자다 forms its causative as 재우다.

c41b4f199c50436a.zh: 「-게 되다」表示被動或自然形成的轉變「變得……」，非使動。
c41b4f199c50436a.en: 자게 됐어요 expresses becoming or ending up sleeping, not an active causative action by Mom.

c7684c7248b88840.zh: 副詞 다시 修飾動詞假設 태어난다면，條件成立後接想成為的對象 새가 되고。
c7684c7248b88840.en: 다시 modifies 태어난다면, which sets the condition for the goal 새가 되고.

c8666537ccb96981.zh: 「도와주기는커녕」置前表示非但沒幫忙，接「방해만 하고 갔어요」表只添了亂就走。
c8666537ccb96981.en: 도와주기는커녕 introduces 'far from helping', followed by the contrasting action 방해만 and verb 하고 갔어요.

cc1b57983ba99dec.zh: 副詞「많이」修飾動詞「오던데」，「-던데」帶出下文提醒。
cc1b57983ba99dec.en: Subject 눈이 is modified by 밖에, adverb 많이 modifies 오던데, and -던데 sets the background.

cc7c0014787ac28e.zh: 「늘다」詞幹無收音，接「-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다」時為「늘」。
cc7c0014787ac28e.en: 늘 combines with the pattern -(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 on the vowel stem 늘다.

cc7c0014787ac28e.zh: 「느는」是現在式定語形態，不能與「수밖에 없다」搭配使用。
cc7c0014787ac28e.en: 느는 is the present-tense modifier form and cannot combine with 수밖에 없다.

cc7c0014787ac28e.zh: 「는」是過去式定語形態，文法「수밖에 없다」前須接「-(으)ㄹ」。
cc7c0014787ac28e.en: 는 is the past modifier form; this grammar structure requires -(으)ㄹ.

cc7c0014787ac28e.zh: 「늘어」是非格式體或非終結形，無法直接修飾依存名詞「수」。
cc7c0014787ac28e.en: 늘어 is an inflected connective stem and cannot directly modify 수.

cc7e9cd0f66b6eb8.zh: 主詞「형은」配名詞謂語修飾形「의사인 반면에」，對比後項主詞「동생은」。
cc7e9cd0f66b6eb8.en: 형은 pairs with 의사인 반면에 to show contrast with the second subject 동생은.

ccea21a2dd2a06dc.zh: 「-고 말았어요」接在語幹「놓치-」後，表達不情願卻最終發生了遺憾的結果。
ccea21a2dd2a06dc.en: 놓치고 말았어요 correctly uses -고 말다 to express regret over an unintended outcome (missing the bus).

ccea21a2dd2a06dc.zh: 「-고 말다」不可接「-어/아」，沒有「-어 말다」的用法。
ccea21a2dd2a06dc.en: -고 말다 requires the connective -고, making 어 말았어요 grammatically incorrect.

ccea21a2dd2a06dc.zh: 「말렸다」是被動或「被阻止」之意，不是表達遺憾結局的輔助動詞「말다」。
ccea21a2dd2a06dc.en: 말렸어요 comes from 말리다 (to stop/prevent), not the auxiliary verb 말다.

ccea21a2dd2a06dc.zh: 「-곤 말다」不是韓語的語法組合，應為「-고 말다」。
ccea21a2dd2a06dc.en: 곤 말았어요 mixes -곤 and 말다, which is grammatically invalid.

d1572581c931e97a.zh: 推測過去狀況不可能發生，使用過去式接「-(으)ㄹ 리가 없다」。
d1572581c931e97a.en: To say a past event cannot have happened, attach -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 to the past stem.

d1572581c931e97a.zh: 「-ㄴ」是過去冠形詞尾，句型固定接「-(으)ㄹ 리가 없다」。
d1572581c931e97a.en: -ㄴ is a past modifier ending; this pattern requires -(으)ㄹ before 리가 없다.

d1572581c931e97a.zh: 「-는」是現在冠形詞尾，文法上不能直接接「리가 없다」。
d1572581c931e97a.en: -는 is a present modifier ending; the pattern requires -(으)ㄹ, not -는.

d1572581c931e97a.zh: 「도착해」是非格式體或連接形，無法修飾名詞「리」。
d1572581c931e97a.en: 도착해 is an infinitive/linking form and cannot modify the noun 리.

d18cd0d1b59edd73.zh: 副詞「이렇게」修飾形容詞「쉬운」，修飾賓語「문제를」，接動詞「틀릴」。
d18cd0d1b59edd73.en: 이렇게 modifies 쉬운, which describes 문제를, followed by 틀릴 modifying 리가 없어요.

d28fe90147a38372.zh: 說話者去了家鄉「갔더니」，隨後察覺「變化很大」的狀況，符合用法。
d28fe90147a38372.en: 갔더니 expresses the speaker's own action of going, followed by noticing a change.

d28fe90147a38372.zh: 「가더니」用於第三人稱（他去了…），第一人稱自己去不能用此形態。
d28fe90147a38372.en: 가더니 describes a third party's action observed in the past, not the speaker's.

d28fe90147a38372.zh: 「갔다니」是用於表達對「去了」這件事感到感嘆或驚訝。
d28fe90147a38372.en: 갔다니 conveys exclamation or disbelief regarding the fact that someone went.

d28fe90147a38372.zh: 「-던데」說的是自己看到別人的事，不能用在自己「回家鄉」的行為上，也接不上後面的發現。
d28fe90147a38372.en: -던데 reports what you saw of others; it cannot describe your own trip home and the discovery that followed.

d2b2a5a6e49ce837.zh: 說話者做了「잤더니」（睡了覺），因而產生後續良好結果，符合用法。
d2b2a5a6e49ce837.en: 잤더니 correctly shows the speaker did the action (slept early), leading to the result.

d2b2a5a6e49ce837.zh: 「-더-」用於回想第三人稱的動作或客觀情況，主語非第一人稱。
d2b2a5a6e49ce837.en: 자더니 is used when observing a third person's behavior, not one's own action.

d2b2a5a6e49ce837.zh: 韓語中沒有「잔더니」這種連接詞尾形態。
d2b2a5a6e49ce837.en: 잔더니 is an incorrect grammatical form in Korean.

d2b2a5a6e49ce837.zh: 「자다」與「-았더니」結合時應縮約為「잤더니」，「자았더니」拼寫錯誤。
d2b2a5a6e49ce837.en: 자- contracts with -았더니 into 잤더니; 자았더니 is an incorrect spelling.

d5d70456cf1ad908.zh: 動詞「마시다」詞幹接「-기만 하면」，表示「一喝就…」。
d5d70456cf1ad908.en: Verb stem 마시- attaches to -기만 하면 to mean whenever I drink.

d5d70456cf1ad908.zh: 「-만」不可直接接在動詞詞幹「마시-」後，需透過「-기」名詞化。
d5d70456cf1ad908.en: The particle -만 cannot attach directly to verb stem 마시- without -기.

d5d70456cf1ad908.zh: 「-기만」應直接接在詞幹「마시-」後，不需經過過去式或非格式體變化。
d5d70456cf1ad908.en: -기만 attaches directly to the verb stem 마시-, not to an inflected form like 마셔-.

d5d70456cf1ad908.zh: 「마시기를」是名詞形加受詞助詞，無法與後方「하면」構成慣用句型。
d5d70456cf1ad908.en: 마시기를 includes the object marker -를 and cannot connect to 하면 here.

d727297676db2f6f.zh: 否定動詞詞幹「않-」搭配冠形詞尾「-는」，組成「-지 않는 한」。
d727297676db2f6f.en: The stem 않- takes modifier -는 to form the pattern -지 않는 한.

d727297676db2f6f.zh: 「않은」是過去式定語，不符合條件句型。
d727297676db2f6f.en: 않은 is past tense and does not fit this conditional pattern.

d727297676db2f6f.zh: 「않을」是未來式定語，不能與「한」構成該文法。
d727297676db2f6f.en: 않을 is future tense and does not form this pattern with 한.
않아 is an informal ending and cannot modify the noun 한.

dafbf527a8bc595f.en: The stem of 하다 ends in a vowel, so it correctly takes -ㄹ수록.
Stems without a final consonant take -ㄹ수록, not -을수록.
dafbf527a8bc595f.zh: 詞幹無收音時不應加「으」，「하을수록」為錯誤形態。

dafbf527a8bc595f.en: There is no ending -는수록; -ㄹ수록 is required here.
dafbf527a8bc595f.zh: 此句型無「-는수록」的接續形式，屬錯誤文法形態。

dafbf527a8bc595f.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ수록 expresses progressive change and is not used with the past tense.
dafbf527a8bc595f.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ수록」表示漸進變化，一般不與過去式結合。

db72e2dfd5b88b3e.zh: 原因子句「돈이 없어서」接「걸어갈 수밖에」，構成無奈結果。
db72e2dfd5b88b3e.en: The cause 돈이 없어서 leads to 걸어갈 수밖에 to complete the fixed pattern.

dbf44e9386231105.zh: 主語 비가 搭配副詞 많이 與否定 오지 않는，連接句尾的 한。
dbf44e9386231105.en: 비가 is modified by 많이 and negated by 오지 않는, linking to 한.

dc14ad61407ab28a.zh: 地點「밖에」接動詞「나가고」，接續「보니」表示發現，後接主詞「비가」。
dc14ad61407ab28a.en: The place 밖에 links to 나가고, followed by 보니 for realization, and 비가 as the subject of raining.

dcc5ba312d99b289.en: The causative pattern -게 하다 directly attaches -게 to the stem 읽-.
dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 使動句型「-게 하다」接在動詞幹「읽-」後，表示讓學生讀。

dcc5ba312d99b289.en: 읽혀 cannot precede 했어요 in this causative structure requiring -게.
dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 使動動詞「읽히다」後不需再疊加「했어요」，且句型要求接「-게」。

dcc5ba312d99b289.en: 읽어 했어요 is ungrammatical; -어 하다 does not create a causative meaning.
dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 「-어 하다」表示對他人感情的描寫，不能形成「讓…做」的使動。

dcc5ba312d99b289.en: 읽기 does not form a causative construction with 하다 here.
dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 「-기 하다」通常用於強調副詞「-기는 하다」，非使動句型。

dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절하다 is an adjective ending in a vowel, so it takes the adjective modifier -ㄴ.
dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절하다」是形容詞，修飾名詞的現在式冠形詞尾接「-ㄴ」。

dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절하는 incorrectly applies the verb modifier -는 to an adjective.
dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절하는」把形容詞誤用了動詞的現在式冠形詞尾「-는」。

dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절할 conveys future tense or speculation rather than a present quality.
dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절할」是未來或推測冠形詞尾，不符合描述已具備特徵的句意。

dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절해 is an informal sentence-ending form and cannot modify the noun 데.
dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절해」是非格式體終結形，無法直接修飾名詞「데」。

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 도 pairs naturally with -(으)ㄴ/는 데다가 to add another point meaning also.
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 文法「-(으)ㄴ/는 데다가」常與後句的「도」（也）呼應。

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 은 is a topic marker and lacks the additive meaning of also required here.
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 「은」是主題標詞，在此處無法像「도」一樣表達「再加上」的語氣。

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 만 means only, contradicting the cumulative meaning of on top of that.
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 「만」表示「只有、僅僅」，與句型疊加特性的邏輯矛盾。

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 을 is an object marker, but 바람 (wind) is the subject of 불다 (blow).
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 「을」是受格標詞，「바람이 불다」中風是主語，不能接受格。

deb0c78f9ab6d510.zh: 主詞「동생이」接時間「아침부터」，加上受詞「기침을」與接續謂語「하더니」連接後文。
deb0c78f9ab6d510.en: Subject 동생이 and time 아침부터 are followed by object 기침을 and 하더니 to link to the result.

dec254720e87ecc5.zh: 主詞「두 사람이」接時間副詞「요즘」，再接片語主語「사이가」及修飾「모양」的形容詞「좋은」。
dec254720e87ecc5.en: Subject 두 사람이 and adverb 요즘 precede 사이가 and the modifier 좋은 before 모양이에요.

df6e21626c481066.zh: 「탓에」表示壞結果的原因或歸咎，符合球隊輸球的情境。
df6e21626c481066.en: 탓에 is used to express blame or the cause of a negative result.

df6e21626c481066.zh: 「덕분에」用於表示多虧某事帶來的正面結果，不符語境。
df6e21626c481066.en: 덕분에 expresses gratitude for a positive result, which does not fit losing.

df6e21626c481066.zh: 「김에」表示「順便」，意思和文法皆不符合此句。
df6e21626c481066.en: 김에 means taking an opportunity to do something, not blaming a cause.
대로 means following or doing as something is, which does not fit.

e09d5aba27c7e118.zh: 主詞「동생은」接受詞「차를」，接動詞「타기만 하면」構成條件句。
e09d5aba27c7e118.en: Subject 동생은 precedes object 차를, followed by conditional 타기만 하면.

e21b9de85135a680.zh: 說話者打了電話「했더니」，隨後發現對方沒接的結果，符合文意。
e21b9de85135a680.en: 했더니 correctly links the speaker's action of calling with the discovered result.

e21b9de85135a680.zh: 「하더니」用於第三人稱的行為回想，不能用於第一人稱的自身動作。
e21b9de85135a680.en: 하더니 is used to recall another person's actions, not the speaker's own action.

e21b9de85135a680.zh: 「했다니」用於對某事表示驚訝或轉述，非前後承接因果發現。
e21b9de85135a680.en: 했다니 expresses exclamation or surprise at a fact, not sequential result.
하던니 is an incorrect and nonexistent grammatical form.

e23f27bb62f2050b.zh: 「-아/어 봤자」表示「就算……也沒用、毫無意義」。
e23f27bb62f2050b.en: Correct. -아/어 봤자 expresses that doing something will be useless or futile.

e23f27bb62f2050b.zh: 「-보니까」表示「做了某事之後發現……」，為事實驗證而非徒勞假設。
e23f27bb62f2050b.en: -보니까 means 'I discovered after trying...', which does not express futility.

e23f27bb62f2050b.zh: 「-보면」表示「如果持續做某事的話」，為一般條件句。
e23f27bb62f2050b.en: -보면 means 'if one continues to do...', lacking the sense of futility.

e23f27bb62f2050b.zh: 「-보고」表示「試著做某事然後……」，僅為單純動作接續。
e23f27bb62f2050b.en: -보고 is just sequential listing ('try doing and then...'), not expressing futility.

e29a35ac49334613.en: To infer a past action from evidence, verbs take -(으)ㄴ 모양이다; 오다 becomes 온.
e29a35ac49334613.zh: 根據路面濕推測「下過雨」，動詞過去推測接「-(으)ㄴ 모양이다」，選「온」。

e29a35ac49334613.en: 오는 모양이다 would mean it seems to be raining right now, not last night.
e29a35ac49334613.zh: 「오는 모양이다」表示推測「正在下雨」，與昨晚下過雨的情境不符。

e29a35ac49334613.en: 올 모양이다 implies a future prediction (it will rain), which conflicts with the wet road.
e29a35ac49334613.zh: 「올 모양이다」表示推測「將要下雨」，無法解釋地上已經濕了的痕跡。

e29a35ac49334613.en: 와 is an informal verb ending and cannot directly modify 모양.
e29a35ac49334613.zh: 「와」是非格式體非敬語詞尾，不能直接修飾名詞「모양」。

e2b3b139bcd98374.zh: 「까지」表「連…也」，可用於正面語境（考試合格）。
e2b3b139bcd98374.en: 까지 means even and works naturally in positive contexts like passing an exam.

e2b3b139bcd98374.zh: 「조차」多用於負面或難以達到的消極情況，不適用此處。
e2b3b139bcd98374.en: 조차 implies an extreme negative situation, so it sounds unnatural with passing.
대로 means in accordance with or as soon as, which does not make sense here.

e2b3b139bcd98374.zh: 「만큼은」表示「至少…/唯獨…」，意思與句意不符。
e2b3b139bcd98374.en: 만큼은 means at least or as much as, altering the intended meaning.

e3cee03d12279d61.zh: 動詞「끝나는」接表示「一……就」的「대로」，再接副詞「바로」修飾「연락할게요」。
e3cee03d12279d61.en: The verb 끝나는 combines with 대로 to mean as soon as it ends, followed by the adverb 바로 and 연락할게요.

e45ec238c705b266.zh: 「-다 보니까」接在일하다後，說明持續一起工作而變得親近。
e45ec238c705b266.en: 보니까 forms -다 보니까, meaning working together over time led to closeness.

e45ec238c705b266.zh: 「-다 보면」表示假設「如果持續……的話」，後半句多為推測或建議。
e45ec238c705b266.en: -다 보면 means if one keeps doing, which is conditional and not for past facts.

e45ec238c705b266.zh: 「일하다 봐서」文法結構錯誤，不能這樣組合。
e45ec238c705b266.en: 일하다 봐서 is grammatically incorrect in Korean.

e45ec238c705b266.zh: 「보러」表示目的「為了看」，語法和語意皆不通順。
e45ec238c705b266.en: 보러 expresses the purpose in order to see, which makes no sense here.

e578f19ed48c03ad.zh: 名詞 너 沒有收音，假設句型接「라면」。
e578f19ed48c03ad.en: 너 ends in a vowel, so it takes 라면 for noun hypotheses.
이라면 is only used after nouns ending in a final consonant.

e578f19ed48c03ad.zh: 「다면」接在形容詞詞幹後，不能直接接名詞。
e578f19ed48c03ad.en: 다면 attaches to adjective stems, not directly to nouns.

e578f19ed48c03ad.zh: 「는다면」接在動詞詞幹後，不能直接接名詞。
e578f19ed48c03ad.en: 는다면 attaches to verb stems, not directly to nouns.

e586d9d47c646019.zh: 修飾名詞「덕분에」表示過去完成的幫助，使用過去冠形詞「도와준」。
e586d9d47c646019.en: The past modifier 도와준 correctly pairs with 덕분에 to express gratitude for past help.

e586d9d47c646019.zh: 「도와줄」表示將來或推測，與已完成的過去事實不符。
e586d9d47c646019.en: 도와줄 is a future modifier, conflicting with the completed past event.

e586d9d47c646019.zh: 「도와줘」為非格式體終結或連接形，無法修飾名詞「덕분」。
e586d9d47c646019.en: 도와줘 is an informal verb ending and cannot directly modify the noun 덕분.

e586d9d47c646019.zh: 「-던데」為回想提示背景的詞尾，不能直接修飾名詞「덕분」。
e586d9d47c646019.en: -던데 is a background-providing sentence ending, not a modifier for 덕분.

e5897cdedd3cea33.zh: 習慣性重複發生的動作，動詞接現在修飾形「-는」成「일하는 셈이에요」，表示算天天上班。
e5897cdedd3cea33.en: For a habitual or ongoing state, the present modifier 일하는 correctly pairs with 셈이에요.

e5897cdedd3cea33.zh: 「일한」是過去完成形，但這裡是描述常態性的每週規律工作。
e5897cdedd3cea33.en: 일한 is the past modifier, but this sentence describes a regular, ongoing weekly routine.

e5897cdedd3cea33.zh: 「일할」是未來或打算形，無法表達「算是在天天上班」的現狀總結。
e5897cdedd3cea33.en: 일할 indicates future or prospective action, which does not fit this general reality.

e5897cdedd3cea33.zh: 「일해」是口語終結形，無法直接接名詞「셈」。
e5897cdedd3cea33.en: 일해 is a sentence ending form and cannot modify the bound noun 셈.

e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나온 forms the set phrase 말이 나온 김에, meaning while we are on the topic.
e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「말이 나온 김에」是固定慣用語，表示「既然話都說到這了」。

e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나오 is just the verb stem and cannot modify the dependent noun 김.
e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「나오」只是動詞詞幹，不能直接修飾依存名詞김에。

e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나와 is a conjugated stem/ending, not an adnominal form that can modify 김에.
e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「나와」是動詞的不規則活用基底，無法直接作冠形詞修飾名詞。

e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나올 is future-oriented, but the phrase requires the past modifier 나온 since words have already emerged.
e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「나올」表將來，但話已經說出口了，必須用過去冠形詞나온。

e65470a13b9e2353.zh: 「-더라도」表「即使……」，搭配「늦게 도착하다」接後續請求。
e65470a13b9e2353.en: Correct. 도착하더라도 means 'even if you arrive (late)', fitting the polite request.

e65470a13b9e2353.zh: 「-더라도요」結尾帶「요」不能在句中作連接詞尾。
e65470a13b9e2353.en: 도착했더라도요 contains the polite ending 요, so it cannot link to the next clause.

e65470a13b9e2353.zh: 「-더니」表過去觀察到的轉變或原因，不表未來假設。
e65470a13b9e2353.en: -더니 links past observations, not hypothetical future situations.

e65470a13b9e2353.zh: 「-하던데」提供過去經歷作背景，不符「即使晚到」的假設語氣。
e65470a13b9e2353.en: -던데 expresses background based on past experience, not a hypothetical condition.

e6ca115350888d19.zh: 名詞「아침」有收音，故接「은커녕」，意為「別說早餐了」。
e6ca115350888d19.en: Correct. 아침 ends in a consonant (받침), so it correctly takes 은커녕.
는커녕 is used after nouns without a final consonant.

e6ca115350888d19.zh: 主格助詞「이」不能與「커녕」組合使用。
e6ca115350888d19.en: 이커녕 is incorrect; the pattern uses 은/는커녕, not 이.

e6ca115350888d19.zh: 受格助詞「을」不能與「커녕」組合使用。
e6ca115350888d19.en: 을커녕 is incorrect; this grammar pattern takes 은/는커녕.

e94516da0ba7e5e5.zh: 句型為「動詞詞幹 + 다 보니」，因此填原形詞幹「먹다」。
e94516da0ba7e5e5.en: The grammar pattern is V-다 보니, so the dictionary stem form 먹다 is correct.

e94516da0ba7e5e5.zh: 「먹어 보니」表示嘗試吃過之後發現，不符合持續吃的文意「계속」。
e94516da0ba7e5e5.en: 먹어 보니 means having tried eating, which does not convey the continuous nature of 계속.

e94516da0ba7e5e5.zh: 「먹고 보니」強調吃完之後才發現，不與副詞「계속」連用。
e94516da0ba7e5e5.en: 먹고 보니 focuses on realizing something after finishing, not ongoing action with 계속.

e94516da0ba7e5e5.zh: 冠形詞形「먹은」無法直接與「보니」組合表達此句型。
e94516da0ba7e5e5.en: 먹은 is an adnominal modifier and cannot attach directly to 보니.

ea183d76641fc9cf.zh: 「-더라도」表假設讓步「即使……」，後常接勸告或意志。
ea183d76641fc9cf.en: Correct. -더라도 expresses hypothetical concession 'even if / no matter how'.

ea183d76641fc9cf.zh: 「-더니」表示因過去經歷的事實而導致某結果，非假設。
ea183d76641fc9cf.en: -더니 expresses past observation and its consequence, not a hypothetical.

ea183d76641fc9cf.zh: 「-던데」表提供過去見聞作為背景說明，非讓步假設。
ea183d76641fc9cf.en: -던데 recalls a past observation to set background, not hypothetical concession.

ea183d76641fc9cf.zh: 「-더라고요」是用於句尾的回想終結詞尾，無法連接後句。
ea183d76641fc9cf.en: -더라고요 is a sentence-ending form expressing past recollection, not a connective.

eb71d8c825b60ea3.zh: 對過去的事情表示「不可能落榜」，需用過去式接「-(으)ㄹ 리가 없다」。
eb71d8c825b60ea3.en: To deny a past outcome, attach -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 to the past stem 떨어졌-.

eb71d8c825b60ea3.zh: 「떨어진」是過去修飾形，後方固定需接「-(으)ㄹ」型態。
eb71d8c825b60ea3.en: 떨어진 is a modifier ending; this construction strictly requires -(으)ㄹ before 리.

eb71d8c825b60ea3.zh: 「떨어지는」是現在進行修飾形，不符合句型與過去語境。
eb71d8c825b60ea3.en: 떨어지는 is the present modifier and does not fit -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다.

eb71d8c825b60ea3.zh: 「떨어져」是動詞詞尾形態，無法直接修飾不完全名詞「리」。
eb71d8c825b60ea3.en: 떨어져 cannot directly modify the bound noun 리.

ec00767b7b10fe6d.zh: 第一人稱自己做了運動「했더니」，導致後面全身痠痛的結果。
ec00767b7b10fe6d.en: 했더니 correctly indicates the speaker's own past action which led to the present result.

ec00767b7b10fe6d.zh: 「하더니」主要用於第三人稱過去重複或持續的動作，不適用於第一人稱。
ec00767b7b10fe6d.en: 하더니 describes another person's observed past action, not the speaker's own.

ec00767b7b10fe6d.zh: 「했다니」表示對聽到的事感到驚訝或感嘆（竟然做了…），不表因果後續。
ec00767b7b10fe6d.en: 했다니 expresses surprise or exclamation about a reported action, not cause and result.

ec00767b7b10fe6d.zh: 「하다」與過去接尾辭結合應為「했-」，「하었더니」形態錯誤。
ec00767b7b10fe6d.en: 하- combines with -였더니 to become 했더니; 하었더니 is an incorrect conjugation.

ecff165cb79385ca.zh: 「-는 김에」表示順便做某事，在此指打掃時順便擦了窗戶。
ecff165cb79385ca.en: 김에 correctly forms -는 김에 to mean doing something additionally while cleaning.

ecff165cb79385ca.zh: 「바람에」表示因某種突發或負面原因導致不良結果，句意不合。
ecff165cb79385ca.en: 바람에 expresses an unintended negative result caused by an event.

ecff165cb79385ca.zh: 「덕분에」表示多虧某事帶來好結果，不是「打掃時順便」的意思。
ecff165cb79385ca.en: 덕분에 means "thanks to" a good result, not "while I was at it".

ecff165cb79385ca.zh: 「탓에」表示「怪罪於……、因為負面緣故」，與文意不合。
ecff165cb79385ca.en: 탓에 blames an action for a bad result, which does not fit here.

ee100f87bd8a332d.zh: 主詞「그 사람은」接帶助詞「인사조차」，再加上否定副詞「안」修飾句尾。
ee100f87bd8a332d.en: The subject 그 사람은 comes first, followed by the object 인사조차, and the negative adverb 안 precedes 했어요.

eed10788ab3bd1f7.zh: 「-는 대로」接在現在式動詞詞幹後，表示「照著……的樣子做」。
eed10788ab3bd1f7.en: 하는 correctly takes the present modifier suffix -는 to form 하는 대로, meaning just as I do.

eed10788ab3bd1f7.zh: 「할」是將來式定語形，不能與表示「照著做」的「대로」搭配。
eed10788ab3bd1f7.en: 할 is the future modifier form and cannot combine with 대로 in this context.

eed10788ab3bd1f7.zh: 「하던데」是表示回想並提供背景的句尾，無法直接修飾「대로」。
eed10788ab3bd1f7.en: 하던데 is a background-providing sentence ending based on recollection, not a modifier for 대로.

eed10788ab3bd1f7.zh: 「해」是動詞不定式或非格式體終結詞尾，無法直接修飾名詞「대로」。
eed10788ab3bd1f7.en: 해 is an informal verb ending or stem form, which cannot directly modify the noun 대로.

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -더라도 attaches to 떨어지- to express a hypothetical concession: even if I fail.
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-더라도」接動詞詞幹，表「即使（考試）落榜」的假設讓步。

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -느라고 indicates that an action caused a negative result, which does not fit here.
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-느라고」表為了做某事而導致負面結果，不符此處假設語境。

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -자마자 means as soon as, which does not fit the intended concession.
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-자마자」表示「一…就…」，不符後句「不會失望」的邏輯。

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -(으)려고 expresses intention or purpose (in order to fail), which makes no sense.
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-(으)려고」表意圖或目的「為了落榜」，語義完全不合理。

efd4c94f7a129bc0.zh: 文法為「-아/어 봤자」，「말하다」接續時變為「말해」。
efd4c94f7a129bc0.en: The pattern is -아/어 봤자, so 말하다 conjugates to 말해.

efd4c94f7a129bc0.zh: 「-아/어 봤자」需要接續詞幹的「-아/어」形，不能直接加詞幹「말하」。
efd4c94f7a129bc0.en: -아/어 봤자 requires the -아/어 form, not the bare stem 말하.

efd4c94f7a129bc0.zh: 「말한」是冠詞形（過去式修飾名詞），不能直接接「봤자」。
efd4c94f7a129bc0.en: 말한 is an adnominal modifier form, not the -아/어 form required before 봤자.

efd4c94f7a129bc0.zh: 「말하고」表示並列或「說完之後」，不能用於「-아/어 봤자」句型。
efd4c94f7a129bc0.en: 말하고 expresses listing or sequence with -고, which cannot combine with 봤자.

f008d150e40b61fc.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 테니까」在此表示推測原因，後句提出建議。
f008d150e40b61fc.en: -(으)ㄹ 테니까 provides a reason based on a conjecture followed by advice.
터니까 is not a valid grammatical form in Korean.

f008d150e40b61fc.zh: 韓語中沒有「테서」這種文法型態。
f008d150e40b61fc.en: 테서 is an incorrect and non-existent form.

f008d150e40b61fc.zh: 韓語中沒有「텐데서」這種結合方式。
f008d150e40b61fc.en: 텐데서 is an incorrect, non-existent combination.

f03e1663e0843b35.zh: 「살다 보면」表示「若持續生活…就會…」，後句接未來的推測「될 거예요」。
f03e1663e0843b35.en: 살다 보면 correctly expresses if you keep living, matching the future result 될 거예요.

f03e1663e0843b35.zh: 「살다 보니」是說明過去做某事而發現的事實，後面不接推測的「될 거예요」。
f03e1663e0843b35.en: -다 보니 describes a realized fact from experience, clashing with the future tense.

f03e1663e0843b35.zh: 「-다 보면」接在原形詞幹後，不可加上過去式詞尾形成「살았다 보면」。
f03e1663e0843b35.en: -다 보면 attaches to basic stems; past-tense 살았다 cannot be used here.

f03e1663e0843b35.zh: 「사다」是「買」，「사다 보면」意思是「買著買著」，文意不符。
f03e1663e0843b35.en: 사다 means to buy, so 사다 보면 means if you keep buying, altering the meaning.

f28210b195d916de.zh: 副詞 그때 修飾 더 열심히，動詞接過去假設 했다면 連接後句。
f28210b195d916de.en: 그때 modifies 더 열심히, followed by the past hypothetical 했다면 leading to the outcome.

f4025c6a701add3c.en: 먹이다 is the causative of 먹다, meaning to feed someone.
먹었어요 is active, meaning Mom ate the food herself.
f4025c6a701add3c.zh: 「먹었어요」為主動形，會變成媽媽自己吃了飯，而非餵小孩。

f4025c6a701add3c.en: 먹혔어요 is passive, which would absurdly mean Mom was eaten by food.
f4025c6a701add3c.zh: 「먹혔어요」是被動形，表示媽媽被飯吃掉，意思荒謬。

f4025c6a701add3c.en: 먹겼어요 is incorrect; 먹다 takes the causative suffix -이-, not -기-.

f70449527b0bbeeb.zh: 「듣다 보니」由詞幹듣-直接加-다 보니，表示持續聽後自然發生的結果。
f70449527b0bbeeb.en: 듣다 보니 combines the stem 듣- with -다 보니 to show a result from continuous listening.

f70449527b0bbeeb.zh: 在「-다 보니」前詞幹不變，寫成「들다 보니」是錯誤形態。
f70449527b0bbeeb.en: The irregular stem does not change before -다, so 들다 보니 is incorrect.

f70449527b0bbeeb.zh: 此句型直接接在動詞詞幹後，不接過去式「들었다」。
f70449527b0bbeeb.en: The pattern attaches directly to the present stem, not the past tense 들었다.

f70449527b0bbeeb.zh: 「듣다 보면」表示「若是持續聽的話」，用於假設或未來推測。
f70449527b0bbeeb.en: 듣다 보면 means if one keeps listening, which is used for future hypotheses.

f71a3a041fdb5fd6.zh: 「-는 바람에」前方固定接動詞詞幹加「-는」。
f71a3a041fdb5fd6.en: -는 바람에 is a fixed pattern taking a verb stem plus -는.
-ㄴ is a past modifying form and cannot attach to 바람에.

f71a3a041fdb5fd6.zh: 「-ㄹ」是將來修飾形，不能接在「바람에」前面。
f71a3a041fdb5fd6.en: -ㄹ is a future modifying form and cannot be used before 바람에.

f71a3a041fdb5fd6.zh: 「울려」是連接詞尾形式，無法直接修飾名詞「바람」。
f71a3a041fdb5fd6.en: 울려 is a conjunctive form and cannot modify the noun 바람.

f71d9765ce19b62a.zh: 時間副詞「이번에는 꼭」修飾賓語「1등을」，後接動詞「하고」搭配文法「말겠어요」。
f71d9765ce19b62a.en: Adverbs 이번에는 꼭 modify 1등을 하고, which connects directly to the ending 말겠어요 for strong resolve.

f741d3e917dfcf99.zh: 「잊어버리다」無收音，接「-ㄹ 게 뻔하다」表示「顯然又會忘記」。
f741d3e917dfcf99.en: The stem 잊어버리- ends in a vowel, correctly taking -ㄹ 게 뻔해요.

f741d3e917dfcf99.zh: 詞幹以母音結尾時應加「-ㄹ」，不可加「-을」。
f741d3e917dfcf99.en: Stems ending in a vowel take -ㄹ, so adding -을 is grammatically incorrect.
잊어버린 is a past modifier; this future/predictive pattern requires -(으)ㄹ.
잊어버려 cannot directly attach to 게 뻔해요.

f847bc1a7998730f.zh: 時間副詞「내일」接主謂句「비가 오더라도」，再接意向「출발할」與句尾「거예요」。
f847bc1a7998730f.en: Time 내일 pairs with clause 비가 오더라도 (even if it rains), preceding 출발할 거예요.

f92cd4a690e9191d.zh: 「조차」接在名詞後，表示連最基本的名字都想不起來的負面狀況。
f92cd4a690e9191d.en: 조차 attaches to nouns to emphasize that even the most basic thing was forgotten.
만큼 indicates degree or comparison (as much as), which does not fit.
대로 means according to or following, making no sense here.

f92cd4a690e9191d.zh: 「뿐」表示「只有、僅僅」，通常後接「이다」，語意不符。
f92cd4a690e9191d.en: 뿐 means only or just, which does not fit this context.

fb280a9dcbf6b41a.zh: 動詞「타다」的陽性母音接「-아」，因此接續「봤자」時為「타」。
fb280a9dcbf6b41a.en: 타다 ends in bright vowel ㅏ, so it connects with -아 to become 타 before 봤자.

fb280a9dcbf6b41a.zh: 「타고」是連接詞尾「-고」，不能與「봤자」搭配使用。
fb280a9dcbf6b41a.en: 타고 uses the connective -고, which cannot combine with 봤자.

fb280a9dcbf6b41a.zh: 「탄」是過去冠形詞尾，用來修飾名詞，不能接「봤자」。
fb280a9dcbf6b41a.en: 탄 is an adnominal modifier form for nouns, not compatible with 봤자.

fb280a9dcbf6b41a.zh: 「타서」表示因果或先後順序，無法與「봤자」組合。
fb280a9dcbf6b41a.en: 타서 expresses cause or sequence with -아서, which cannot attach to 봤자.

fb6b2a729b590047.zh: 接「-(으)ㄹ 테니까」表說話者意圖，無尾音接「준비할」。
fb6b2a729b590047.en: Follows the pattern -(으)ㄹ 테니까 for intentions; 준비하다 takes 준비할.

fb6b2a729b590047.zh: 「-는」是動詞現在式定語詞尾，不能與「테니까」搭配。
fb6b2a729b590047.en: -는 is the present-tense modifier; it cannot combine with 테니까.

fb6b2a729b590047.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ」是過去式定語詞尾，此處表示未來的打算。
fb6b2a729b590047.en: -(으)ㄴ indicates the past modifier, but here future intention is meant.

fb6b2a729b590047.zh: 「준비해」是非格式體非敬語詞尾，不能直接接「테니까」。
fb6b2a729b590047.en: 준비해 is an informal ending and cannot attach directly to 테니까.

fc8db5ade6850e66.zh: 副詞短語「좀 더 일찍」修飾動詞「출발할걸」，後接「그랬어요」表後悔。
fc8db5ade6850e66.en: The adverb phrase 좀 더 일찍 modifies出発할걸, which naturally connects to 그랬어요 in the regret pattern.

fc9e3193cafee3ea.zh: 친구도配만날 겸表第一個目的，接著並列第二個目的受詞쇼핑도。
fc9e3193cafee3ea.en: 친구도 pairs with 만날 겸 for the first goal, linking to the second goal 쇼핑도.

fd264adc3e8c56e6.zh: 動詞語幹「가-」接「-곤 했어요」，表達小時候「經常去」的過去習慣。
fd264adc3e8c56e6.en: Attaching -곤 했어요 to 가- correctly forms 가곤 했어요, expressing a past frequent habit.

fd264adc3e8c56e6.zh: 韓語中沒有「-곤 되다」的句型搭配。
fd264adc3e8c56e6.en: 곤 됐어요 is an unnatural and invalid grammatical combination.

fd264adc3e8c56e6.zh: 「-고 했어요」表示並列或轉述，無法自然表達童年經常去的反覆習慣。
fd264adc3e8c56e6.en: 고 했어요 denotes listing actions or hearsay rather than a repeated past habit.

fd264adc3e8c56e6.zh: 表達習慣時須搭配動詞「하다」，不能使用「-곤 있다/있었어요」。
fd264adc3e8c56e6.en: 곤 있었어요 is ungrammatical; the habitual pattern requires 하다, not 있다.

fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.zh: 「열다」為ㄹ不規則動詞，遇到「-ㄴ」時ㄹ脫落變為「연」，接「채」表開著窗的狀態。
fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.en: 열다 has an irregular ㄹ drop before -ㄴ, correctly becoming 연 to form 연 채.

fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.zh: 「열다」遇到以輔音「ㄴ」開頭的詞尾時「ㄹ」會脫落，不能寫成「열은」。
fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.en: 열은 is incorrect because the stem-final ㄹ drops when attaching -(으)ㄴ, yielding 연 instead.

fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.zh: 「여는」是現在式定語形，本句型要求使用過去定語形表示動作完成後的狀態。
fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.en: 여는 is the present modifier form; this grammar pattern requires the past modifier -(으)ㄴ.

fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.zh: 「열」僅為詞幹，無法直接修飾名詞「채」。
fd3f4fe59bcef9e4.en: 열 is merely the verb stem and cannot directly modify the dependent noun 채.

fdb79b380acb7321.zh: 「-고 보니」表示做完某動作之後才發覺某事，填「끊고」正好符合。
fdb79b380acb7321.en: 끊고 forms -고 보니, expressing realizing something only after finishing the call.

fdb79b380acb7321.zh: 「끊다 보니」表示反覆持續掛電話的過程中，不符語境。
fdb79b380acb7321.en: 끊다 보니 implies a discovery from repeatedly hanging up over time.

fdb79b380acb7321.zh: 「끊어 보니」表示嘗試掛電話看看，不符原句想表達的意思。
fdb79b380acb7321.en: 끊어 보니 means tried hanging up and found out, which does not fit.

fdb79b380acb7321.zh: 句型「-고 보니」前不接過去式「끊었고」。
fdb79b380acb7321.en: The pattern -고 보니 takes the stem without the past suffix -었-.

fe2cec2a11054513.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 리가 없다」為固定慣用句型，表示「絕不可能」。
fe2cec2a11054513.en: -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 is the set pattern meaning there is no way or reason.

fe2cec2a11054513.zh: 「리가 안 돼요」不是韓語的自然慣用搭配。
fe2cec2a11054513.en: 리가 안 돼요 is not a natural Korean expression for this pattern.

fe2cec2a11054513.zh: 「리가 못 해요」文法錯誤，「리」後習慣接「없다」或「있다」。
fe2cec2a11054513.en: 리가 못 해요 is ungrammatical; 리 takes 없다 or 있다.

fe2cec2a11054513.zh: 「없다」前的主格助詞通常用「가」，不用受格助詞「를」。
fe2cec2a11054513.en: The subject marker 가 is required with 없다 here, not the object marker 를.

ffb7d4a004d95af5.zh: 「끝나다」為自動詞，表示已經差不多結束了，過去修飾形接「끝난 셈이에요」。
ffb7d4a004d95af5.en: The past modifier 끝난 correctly indicates that the work is practically finished already.

ffb7d4a004d95af5.zh: 「끝나는」是現在進行修飾形，與「거의 다（差不多都）」表完成的語意不合。
ffb7d4a004d95af5.en: 끝나는 is the present modifier, which contradicts the completed result implied by 거의 다.

ffb7d4a004d95af5.zh: 「끝날」是未來推測形，無法表達「算已經結束了」的事實評價。
ffb7d4a004d95af5.en: 끝날 is the future modifier, which cannot express that an event has practically finished.

ffb7d4a004d95af5.zh: 「끝나」不能直接修飾名詞「셈」，必須加修飾語尾。
ffb7d4a004d95af5.en: 끝나 is an unconjugated base ending and cannot directly modify the noun 셈.

ffb8da60411fac2b.zh: 「먹을걸」符合「-(으)ㄹ걸 그랬다」表達後悔吃太多的文法。
ffb8da60411fac2b.en: 먹을걸 correctly uses -(으)ㄹ걸 그랬다 to express regret about eating too much.

ffb8da60411fac2b.zh: 標準拼寫應為「먹을걸」，寫成緊音「껄」是不正確的標記法。
ffb8da60411fac2b.en: 먹을껄 is a spelling mistake based on pronunciation; the standard spelling is 먹을걸.

ffb8da60411fac2b.zh: 表達後悔的「-(으)ㄹ걸 그랬다」直接加在詞幹後，不加過去式標記。
ffb8da60411fac2b.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ걸 그랬다 attaches to present verb stems, not past stems like 먹었을걸.

ffb8da60411fac2b.zh: 「-는걸」是感嘆詞尾，無法與「그랬어요」搭配形成後悔句型。
ffb8da60411fac2b.en: 먹는걸 uses the exclamatory ending -는걸 and cannot be followed by 그랬어요.

ffcf3565b4075006.zh: 「아무리 비싸 봤자」表示「再貴也就…」，符合句型「-아/어 봤자」。
ffcf3565b4075006.en: 비싸 봤자 uses -아/어 봤자 to express even at the most expensive.

ffcf3565b4075006.zh: 「-아/어 보니」表示做了某事後得知事實，與此處的假設推測不合。
ffcf3565b4075006.en: -아/어 보니 means upon experiencing something, unlike the hypothetical limit here.

ffcf3565b4075006.zh: 「-아/어 보면」表示「如果試著做做看」，不符合此處表達上限的語境。
ffcf3565b4075006.en: -아/어 보면 means if one tries doing something, not even at the most.

ffcf3565b4075006.zh: 「-아/어 봐서」表示原因或嘗試經驗，無法表達「再貴也不過…」。
ffcf3565b4075006.en: -아/어 봐서 expresses cause or experience, not an upper limit estimation.
